notes:
Security hardening update
- Paid features now require successful server verification in the current app session.
- Forged local JWT/auth URI data no longer unlocks project or proxy execution.
- Server HMAC verification now fails closed when APP_HMAC_SECRET is missing.
- Backup, restore, and Drive token refresh APIs now enforce trial/subscription state.
